Replaying a prior or pre-existing synthetic receipt is refused; only then may the capability row enter SCORECARD.md.
claims.killRule: No live driver invocation; absent, stale or mismatched invocation nonce; reused output path; fewer than 8 samples; non-increasing timestamps or observed span below 1000 ms; unavailable ss/proc or nonpositive ticks on any sample/final sweep; nonzero observed nonLoopback count; empty owned tree; differing firstShotSha256; survivors; fixture port not verifiably closed; unbound browserVersion; or round-39 receipt reaches exit 0.
claims.source: S145 (proc_pid_net(5), reopened 2026-10-27; DESCRIPTION /proc/net/tcp), cited by the round-40 receipt and lesson Gate.
